versions.changelog:
Initial release of short-fiction manuscript formatting skill.

- Formats a single short story as a Courier New 12 pt `.docx`, following Shunn's modern short-story rules.
- Handles contact block, title, byline, rounded word count, scene breaks (`#`), running header, and all required manuscript elements.
- Enforces one space between sentences, italics for emphasis, curly quotes, and double hyphen (`--`) for dashes in Courier.
- Refuses to format novels, works with chapters, Shunn Classic (two spaces), or copyright lines.
- Validates input against modern rules, stops on rule conflicts, and runs a self-test to check refusals.
- Provides clear output and error messages; `.docx` is ready for submission.
